english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a doctor.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for a medical doctor, without specifically contrasting internal medicine with surgery.

examples.english: I need to see a doc tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

examples.english: My son has a fever, so I’m taking him to see a physician.
examples.traditional: 我個仔發燒，我帶佢去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 faat3 siu1 ngo5 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1
